proposal.inferred_root_cause: PSP degradation on the wallet path for wallet:paytm at 32% success over 96 attempts
proposal.reasoning_trace: wallet:paytm has dropped to 32% success over 96 attempts against a 90% portfolio baseline, and the only open notice names wallet:phonepe, a different issuer on the same method. Partial success means the issuer is reachable, so the losses are concentrated in the gateway hop the code points at. The open notice on wallet:phonepe is a different issuer and explains nothing here. This is a recurring debit, so RBI's 24-hour cooling window is longer than any backoff this class would justify: the timing is set by regulation, not by the hazard estimate, and the pre-debit notice has to go out before the retry does.
